description: This header file declares a function for creating a new 'load configs' command handler in the Cuttlefish project's C++ codebase. It includes necessary headers and defines a namespace, with a focus on loading, translating, and creating Cuttlefish instances based on JSON configuration.

methods.name: NewLoadConfigsCommand
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a CvdCommandHandler that handles loading configuration files for Cuttlefish instances.
